title: Gloomhaven
subtitle: Euro-inspired tactical combat in a persistent, evolving world of high fantasy
tagline: Venture into the unforgiving shadows of the Sleeping Lion
loreSummary: You are wandering mercenaries with your own special set of skills. In the harsh wilderness on the edge of civilization, every choice permanently alters the world around you.
keyFeatures: Card-driven deterministic combat (No dice, pure tactical strategy)
Retirement & Class Unlocking (Personal Quests drive new character growth)
Branching Narrative (Town & Road events, world stickers, prosperity tracker)

core_campaign.name: Standard Core Campaign
core_campaign.description: The main storyline arc to the final boss plus key side-quests and 2-3 character retirement chains.

story_speedrun.name: Main Story Focus (Speedrun)
story_speedrun.description: Direct path through the primary questlines to the final boss with minimal optional side dungeon diversions.

extended_campaign.name: Extended Campaign Experience
extended_campaign.description: Main story, numerous character unlocks, town records progression, and side quest chains.

completionist.name: Full Completionist (All Accessible)
completionist.description: Attempting every unlockable scenario, high prosperity, all class retirements, and high-level side dungeons.

milestones.title: The Merchant's Ambition
milestones.phase: Phase I - The Black Barrow & Crypts
milestones.description: Uncovering Jekserah's necromantic schemes in the city crypts and surviving the bandit commander.

milestones.title: The Demon Rift
milestones.description: Sealing the planar rift beneath Gloomhaven and confronting elemental demons in the searing chasm.

milestones.title: The Voice Unchained
milestones.description: Scaling the Copperneck Mountains to locate the ancient artifacts and deciding the fate of the Voice.

milestones.title: The Gloom of Gloomhaven
milestones.description: Descending into the city sanctuary to confront the eternal corruption threatening all of Gloomhaven.
